t: Four things named together as one condition
a: يَتَقَارَبُ الزَّمَانُ وَيَنْقُصُ الْعَمَلُ، وَيُلْقَى الشُّحُّ وَيَكْثُرُ الْهَرْجُ
p: Yataqārabu-z-zamānu wa yanquṣu-l-ʿamal, wa yulqa-sh-shuḥḥu wa yakthuru-l-harj
m: Time will draw close together, deeds will decrease, miserliness will be cast in, and harj will increase.
